title: The Son's coming to the Ancient of Days is into the Father's glory
english: What then does it mean, “He reached as far as the Ancient of Days” (Daniel 7:13)? Clearly the Son reached into the glory of the Father. And from where is it possible to see this? He himself said again next: “To him was given the honor and the kingdom” (Daniel 7:14). For he heard the Father saying, “Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet” (Psalm 109:1).

title: The Son reached the Father's glory
english: Did he reach it? Clearly the Son reached into the glory of the Father. And how can we see this? He himself said next: “To him was given the honor and the kingdom” (Daniel 7:14). For he heard the Father saying, “Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet” (Psalm 110:1).
